fields.phone: text (candidate phone; NOT set in users.phone until verified)
fields.is_used: bool (production field; set true on consume)

temporary_fields_isolated_env_only.adapter_status: select: pending_send, sent_active, send_failed, expired, consumed
temporary_fields_isolated_env_only.requesting_user_id: text (D23-4: stores e.auth.id from request; required for verification)

key_fields.phone: text (only written by OTP adapter TX-3 or NSU emergency recovery)

otp_user_binding.purpose: Binds OTP to the requesting user. TX-3 rejects e.auth.id != requesting_user_id.

expiry_design.pattern: Return-from-TX commits expired state; throw outside TX rejects the request.

tx2_cleanup_design.error_handling: Not swallowed. 500 returned if cleanup fails (mode: db_fail_request_cleanup_fail).

transaction_api.note: D22-2 false limitation removed. D23-5/6 patterns correct.

rate_limit_note: D23-12: Persistent rate-limit policy DEFERRED-MANDATORY. No safety claim made.
